name: dumbbell pullover on floor
description: A pullover lying on the floor, which limits the stretch range and keeps the focus on the lats and chest.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold one dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the weight in an arc behind your head until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pull it back over your chest using your lats.
Keep your ribs down and core tight throughout.
